label: AQA-style practice (Revision-authored, not an AQA question)

question.stem: Harbour Homewares Ltd reports revenue of £800,000, gross profit of £280,000 and cost of sales of £520,000 for the year. Calculate its gross profit margin.

option_rationale: B is incorrect: it uses cost of sales as a percentage of revenue (£520,000 ÷ £800,000 × 100).
C is incorrect: it divides gross profit by cost of sales rather than by revenue (£280,000 ÷ £520,000 × 100).
D is incorrect: £280,000 ÷ £800,000 = 0.35, but this must be multiplied by 100 to express the margin as a percentage.
mark_scheme.model_answer: Gross profit margin = gross profit ÷ revenue × 100 = £280,000 ÷ £800,000 × 100 = 35%.
